mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quiz_results WHERE user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_results (id, user_id, question_id, selected_answer, is_correct, created_at) VALUES (#{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{questionId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{selectedAnswer}, #{isCorrect}, #{createdAt})
